author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** #20 ships dashboard polling (5s LocalResource refetch). design.md §5.1 calls for live updates via WebSocket; polling satisfies the spec for v1 but does not meet the 'live' goal at scale. Follow-up wires real-time push.

**Deliverables.**
- Backend: GET /api/dashboard/live WebSocket endpoint via axum::extract::ws; subscribes to the event bus (#16) and forwards typed DashboardEvent messages.
- Frontend: replace polling with WebSocket subscription using web-sys/gloo-net WS; fall back to polling if WS connection fails.
- Same DashboardSnapshot DTO; diff-based event payload (NewCluster, NewSignal, VolumeBucketUpdated, ModeratorLoadDelta).

**Done when.** Dashboard reflects new observations within 1 second of detection (was 5s with polling). Fallback to polling if WS reconnect fails.
